front.title: A Provenance-Bounded Record Format for Scientific Data

abstract.t: This document specifies a JSON record format for scientific data and the claims derived from it. Each record binds a claim to an immutable source digest, a claim class, an evidence tier, a mandatory falsifier, a set of typed check results, and a provenance trail. Processing is fail-closed: a missing, unknown, or not-run check blocks admissibility. The format proves custody and unchanged bytes. It does not certify that a claim is true.
